description: For each file path and const uint8_t* key parameter, generate 12-byte nonce with RAND_bytes(), encrypt file content using AES-256-GCM via EVP_CIPHER_CTX interface (libcrypto), write output as [12 nonce][ciphertext][16 GCM tag] to original_filename.PROCESSED. Overwrite original with zeros using fwrite() of zero-filled buffer, then remove() original.
name: apply_transform
